parents.course: Art-Centered Learning at the Secondary Level

ns2:section.sectionText: ARTE 302 is a practicum course with a variable schedule in the schools. Seminar will be held on Tuesday mornings for 1/2 of the students. Those students will be teaching in public schools on Thursday mornings. Seminar will be held on Thursday mornings for other 1/2 of the students. Those students will be teaching in public schools on Tuesday mornings. Keep your Tuesday and Thursday mornings open from 8am -12. No classes before. Meet the first week on the day your professor has emailed you about prior to school starting.
